messages.subject: Datalogging During Aerial/Shipboard Surveys
messages.body_plain:
Hello Distance-Samplers,

Who on this planet is using existing Datalogging/DAQ technology to log
data
from digital inclinometers (sighting angles to animals), aircraft/ship
attitude sensors (either built-in electronics or stand alone attitude
sensing units), and weather sensors (light, temperature) during transect
surveys?  I'm particularly interested in whether anyone is logging this
data for use in determining sightability conditions and distance from the
sighting platform.

A related question, is anyone using aerial/shipboard videography of the
transect belt and beyond to record imagery of animal habitat during
transect surveys?

Any contact information (email, website, phone number, mailing address)
would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks,

Ted Elliott
LGL Limited
environmental research associates
22 Fisher St., P.O. Box 280
King City, ON, L7B 1A6
CANADA
Tel:  905 833-1244

messages.subject: SCANS reference request?
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

a general request - I am looking for a paper which was published
concerning the results of the SCANS survey. I don't have a title for
it but it details the methods and analysis of the distance-sampling
data for the estimation of cetacean abundances in the North Sea. I
believe one of the authors was D. Borchers and the paper was in
Biometrics (possibly) and was published late last year/early 2000?

If anyone has any idea of the paper I'm talking about, it would be
much appreciated if they could give me a complete reference or if
possible, send me a photocopy of it.

Apologies for such a general request but I have searched
journals/authors on the net and could not locate it.

Many thanks
Kelly
************************************************
